Type: faux fur throw cushion
Use: cozy accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: curly shaggy faux fur
Colors: ivory, warm white
Shape: square, dense curly pile texture, soft rounded edges, plush, generously sized
Feel: soft, luxurious, cozy, warm
Goes with: grey, beige or black upholstery, light wood, metallic accents; Scandinavian, glam or modern bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Faux Fur Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Luxurious, 20" x 20", Ivory
product.description: Add a touch of luxury to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes glamour along with a shag texture for warmth and coziness. For a different look, flip it over to the solid ivory side. Neutral ivory enhances any style room. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
